Chapter 6614: Heart Of Loyalty

Chapter 6614: Heart Of Loyalty

The sword seemed to be as heavy as heaven and earth in his grasp. Thus, a swing could crush all of space.

“A heavy sword forged by Dingtian.” Everyone shuddered after the introduction. The material was impressive but most importantly, the creator.

This might not be an immortal-level artifact but it couldn’t be far off. The value of this sword was a testament to Dingtian’s high regard for his general.

Everyone felt suffocated by the presence of the sword. No treasures or merit laws could stop it.

“Excuse me then.” His battle intent erupted across the realms. The stallion and his armor also exuded the same battle intent.

The latter was not there due to his cultivation but rather from the countless near-death battles they experienced together with him. The culmination of life, death, courage, and murder manifested into something immensely destructive.

Crowd members smartly retreated. This included Visceraless Young Noble and Jiu Ning. However, this was because the duo didn’t know what Li Qiye would do with his primordial power.

“Heart of Loyalty!” He chanted a mantra, causing the white blade to turn dark.

It sucked in everything nearby - the various affinities, powers, and even cultivators.

Once he gathered enough power, he roared: “Destruction!”

Instead of an apocalyptic slash, the slash created a black hole. Everything turned dark for the spectators since time, space, and light were sucked inside. All converged into a singularity.

The largest stars and strongest cultivators still couldn’t survive inside this black hole as they were crushed and added to the singularity. It gave the impression of being an attack at the overlord level.

Many roared in horror because they didn’t wish to be added to his attack.

“Such power.” Grand Preceptor and Dugu Yuan had serious expressions.

“Bam!” The blade and its black hole struck Li Qiye, fully engulfing him. However, this power did not affect Li Qiye.

He stood still and used his physical body to meet the blade. Godstallion initially celebrated the direct hit.

Alas, he saw that Li Qiye was unscathed without using any treasure or merit law. In this split second, he became horrified. Even an overlord wouldn’t use their body to bear the brunt of this attack.

Spectators couldn’t believe their eyes while Li Qiye finally made a move, clutching the blade tightly. Godstallion found himself somehow immobilized as well, not just his blade.
